protocol: 100 held-out scene-grouped validation images, identical for every row. Each classical method denoises at 128x128 then upsamples 2x bicubically; our model does both jointly. LPIPS uses AlexNet.
note: Our model exceeds the oracle bound on PSNR and LPIPS. The bound upper-limits local transform-domain shrinkage followed by BICUBIC upsampling; a learned method that also learns the upsampling prior can legitimately exceed it.
